entries.caption:
We've launched HumanFilter's free desktop beta. 

People should be able to decide how much recognized AI-labeled content and which topics they see online. HumanFilter's free desktop beta makes that decision local and reversible, with per-site controls, chosen keywords and Show once. It does not identify every unlabeled AI post.

We're interested in feedback from people actually using the free desktop beta, including what labels or site layouts it misses. The product link and manual installation instructions are in our first comment.

Local first. 

HumanFilter doesn't require a signup or upload your social feed to Evercraft. It evaluates supported website text and recognized AI disclosures locally in your browser, with preferences stored on your own device. Website layouts can change; this is a free desktop beta and we publish its limits.
